brief_summary: A number line of switch retail pack sizes (10, 45, 90, 110) with the 20-to-30-switch per-half need of a 40-to-60-key split board marked twice — once per half, as two stacked amber bands — with dashed diagonals showing each half independently rounds up to the same 45-pack, and a bracket calling out that the rounding happens twice, per half, rather than once, per board.
